description:
Found by the fz-kdt.210 cold review (probes P5 and P10) and confirmed by the
builder at the fz-kdt.210 commit. LATENT: not reachable from the shipped
runtime library, which declares no map-typed and no multi-clause @spec.

fz-kdt.210 marks a variable UNDETERMINED at ONE site --
`collect_match_subst`, when the NODE'S MERGED OUTCOME is `MatchWitness::Unknown`.
That delivers "no node the walk visited was wholly unreadable". It does NOT
deliver the stronger "every covariant occurrence was individually read",
because two collectors skip a single occurrence WITHOUT recursing while a
sibling keeps the node's merged outcome `Known`:

1. `collect_map_match` -- a pattern key the witness does not name is
   `continue`d, and no `Invalid` is raised when the witness carries variables
   (precisely the case where the key might yet appear). A sibling key that IS
   read makes the node `Known`.

2. `collect_arrow_match` -- a pattern clause no witness clause matches on
   ARITY is skipped. A sibling clause that DID match makes the node `Known`.
   Weaker than (1): the skipped clause is uninhabited by that witness, so the
   skip is arguably principled.

REPRODUCERS, both pinned KNOWN-WRONG in src/compiler2/types/arrow_match.rs
(they assert the wrong answer and say so, and they fail loudly if the hole
closes):

  p5_a_skipped_map_key_is_a_partial_join_the_node_rule_misses
    f(a, %{:k => c, :missing => a}) :: a   at  (int, alpha | %{:k => int})
    answers `Known int`; `a`'s `:missing` occurrence was never read.

  p10_a_skipped_arrow_clause_is_a_partial_join_the_node_rule_misses
    f(c, ((any) -> b) | ((any, any) -> c)) :: c   at  (int, (any) -> int)
    answers `Known int`; the arity-2 clause was never read.

THE FIX SHAPE (correct-by-construction): mark at the two skip sites, i.e. call
`collect_lower_occurrences` on the pattern subtree the collector declined to
descend into, rather than only on a wholly-unreadable node. Then re-measure the
match_arrow verdict census and the refine_call_return CARVE/FILL census -- the
fz-kdt.210 commit message records both at its own head.

WHY IT WAS NOT DONE IN fz-kdt.210: neither hole is reachable from the shipped
library, so it moves no corpus artifact today, and 210's own gate was already
a whole-corpus re-measurement. Deliberately deferred, with the holes pinned so
they cannot be forgotten.
title: A partial join is marked per NODE, so a collector that skips ONE covariant occurrence still answers Known: collect_map_match's absent key and collect_arrow_match's arity-incompatible clause
